item_name: Insulin — Insulin injections (number of days insulin injections were received)

lookback_source.quote: Enter in Item N0350A, the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that insulin injections were received.

lookback_notes: 7-day look-back period, or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days. The manual does not state on this page how the 7 days are counted relative to the ARD.

coding_levels.label: Insulin injections — number of days
coding_levels.definition: Record the number of days that insulin injections were received during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days.

source.quote: A. Insulin injections Record the number of days that insulin injections were received during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days

federal_coding_rules.rule: Enter in Item N0350A the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that insulin injections were received.

source.quote: Enter in Item N0350A, the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that insulin injections were received.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For subcutaneous insulin pumps, code only the number of days that the resident actually required a subcutaneous injection to restart the pump.

source.quote: For subcutaneous insulin pumps, code only the number of days that the resident actually required a subcutaneous injection to restart the pump.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Insulin injections are counted in this item (N0350) as well as in Item N0300, Injections.

source.quote: Insulin injections are counted in this item as well as in Item N0350.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medication administration records for the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

source.quote: Review the resident's medication administration records for the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

federal.notes: Step 1 of Steps for Assessment for N0350.

federal.criterion: Determine from the record whether the resident received insulin injections during the look-back period, and count the number of days insulin injections were received.

source.quote: Determine if the resident received insulin injections during the look-back period.

federal.notes: Steps 2 and 4 of Steps for Assessment; step 4 states "Count the number of days insulin injections were received and/or insulin orders changed."

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied Section N pages do not tie N0350A to any payment or case-mix classification.

not_found: exact counting of the 7-day window relative to the ARD
